name: Ducati 851 / 888
engine: 851 or 888 cc liquid-cooled four-valve desmo V-twin, fuel injected
intro: The first four-valve Desmoquattro Ducatis. Fuel injected, belt cams and a dry clutch.

H: Desmo valve service needs both opening and closing shims checked. Follow the interval in the manual; it is not a job to skip.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
